notes: Wyoming imposes no individual or corporate income tax (rate 0%, $0 collected; see Wyo. Const. Art. 15, Sec. 18 per the Legislative Service Office tax structure summary).
Sales/use tax and property tax are not modeled.

seDeduction.note: Not applicable: Wyoming has no personal income tax.

seHealthInsurance.note: Not applicable: Wyoming has no personal income tax.

retirementContributions.note: Not applicable: Wyoming has no personal income tax.

qbi.note: Not applicable: Wyoming has no personal income tax.

localIncomeTax.note: No city or county income taxes in Wyoming.

estimatedTax.threshold: None: Wyoming has no personal income tax, so no state estimated income tax payments are due.

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $100 (Articles of Organization, Wyoming Secretary of State; fee schedule effective July 1, 2026).
businessCosts.annualReportFee: Annual report license tax, due each year on the first day of the LLC's anniversary month: the greater of $60 or two-tenths of one mill ($0.0002) per dollar of the company's assets located and employed in Wyoming (i.e. $60 for $300,000 or less of Wyoming assets).
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None beyond the annual report license tax above (no franchise or income tax).
